title: Interactive Tutorials with Quarto and WebR
text: learnr2 creates interactive R tutorials run entirely reader’s web browser using Quarto WebR, via quarto-live extension. offers learnr-style authoring conveniences — scaffolding, exercises, hints, solutions, quizzes — without Shiny, R Markdown, server. rendered tutorial self-contained HTML page.

title: Interactive Tutorials with Quarto and WebR
text: Live code cells — editable, runnable R executes browser. Exercises — cells blanks, plus .hint .solution blocks. Automatic grading — powered gradethis. Quiz questions — question() / quiz(), graded browser plain JavaScript, including single/multiple choice, free-text, reflection questions. Answers persist browser’s localStorage. See reference index bundled hello-learnr2 tutorial details.

Create a quiz question — question
text: learnr-style quiz question, rendered small self-contained, client-side interactive widget — Shiny R server required. Supports single-choice ("radio"), multiple-choice ("checkbox"), free-text questions, graded entirely reader's browser.

title: Create a quiz question — question
code: question(   text,   ...,   type = c("auto", "single", "multiple", "text", "reflection", "reflection_editable"),   correct = "Correct!",   incorrect = "Incorrect.",   allow_retry = FALSE,   random_answer_order = FALSE,   submit_button = "Submit Answer",   try_again_button = "Try Again",   id = NULL,   allow_image = FALSE )

title: Create a quiz question — question
text: text Question prompt. ... One answer() objects. type Question type. "auto" (default) picks "single" exactly one answer marked correct, "multiple" otherwise. types: "text" – free-text question, graded comparing (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, case-insensitive) reader's response answer() text(s). "reflection" – ungraded free-response question. submitting, reader sees model answer (correct answer() text(s)) response locked. "reflection_editable" – like "reflection", reader's response stays editable model answer revealed, can keep revising . correct Message shown reader answers correctly. Unused "reflection"/"reflection_editable" questions. incorrect Message shown reader answers incorrectly. Unused "reflection"/"reflection_editable" questions. allow_retry Allow reader try incorrect answer? Defaults FALSE. Unused "reflection"/"reflection_editable" questions. random_answer_order Shuffle answer order time page loads? Defaults FALSE. applies "single"/"multiple" questions. submit_button, try_again_button Button labels. id Stable identifier used key reader's saved answer (see "Progress persistence" ). Defaults slug derived text. Set explicitly plan edit question wording later want readers' saved answers survive edit. allow_image "reflection"/"reflection_editable" questions, let reader paste PNG image (e.g. screenshot) clipboard, alongside typed response – file upload, just Ctrl+V/Cmd+V question. Defaults FALSE. Ignored question types.
